title: CBG BILLS NOTICE MAY 18 2022
text:
NOTICE
ISSUE OF 49- DAY CENTRAL BANK BILLS
Tender for 49-day Central Bank Bills amounting to D1,000,000,000 will be issued and
settled tomorrow, Wednesday May 18, 2022. Tender closes at 2.30 p.m.
Given that the Central Bank Bills are not issued on the Security Settlement System (SSS)
yet, completed applications with official signatures and Stamp should be submitted
online at omo@cbg.gm, before 2.30 p.m. on May 18, 2022. Please note that the ceiling
on the CBG bills yield is the weighted average of the 91-day T-bills of May 18, 2022,
auction which is 1.69%.
Copies of the General Conditions and guidelines of Issue and Redemption of the
Securities can be downloaded from the Central Bank Website at www.cbg.gm.
BANKING DEPARTMENT
CENTRAL BANK OF THE GAMBIA
May 17, 2022
NB: Application forms attached
